opentrain.ai/authoring-retry.allowedRetryAction: Inspect the same folder/page/asset. Explicitly repeat cancellation only while cancelable. Never infer cancellation from a missing asset or allocate a replacement after an uncertain provider outcome.
opentrain.ai/authoring-retry.staleStateBehavior: READY is immutable and cannot be canceled. A missing row/404 or uncertain provider result requires reconciliation, not success.

description: Release a PENDING private audio / file upload you prepared. "canceled" confirms the release; "ready" means the asset was finalized first and stays (READY assets are never deleted). Convergent. Requires current employer folder access. Empty destinations require reviewed activation; published/unknown delivery writes refuse without changing release/read/ack flags. Requires instructions:write.
